Disease of the trigeminal cranial nerve; no additional organ involvement applies across the umbrella.
Middle-ear disease with bloody effusion; transudative otitis does not establish an infectious or autoimmune mechanism.

Reproductive erectile dysfunction; a vascular, endocrine, or neurologic cause is not required by this umbrella.

Autoimmune skin sclerosis; GI dysmotility/fibrosis affects >70% and interstitial lung disease roughly 50-70%. Renal crisis is a minority complication.

Interferonopathy with phalangeal osteolysis 8/8 and aortic valve calcification 5/7; glaucoma 10/11. Psoriasiform skin disease 7/11 omitted at cap.
Tumors of female reproductive organs; no covered organ is intrinsic across this umbrella.
Adipocytic soft-tissue sarcoma, typically arising in deep soft tissues; subcutaneous origin and distant organ spread are not universal.
